title: Zkeytune
tagline: A zero knowledge messaging social app using web3 and zero knowledge to protect your privacy
description:
A zero knowledge messaging social app using web3 and zero knowledge to protect your privacy. It is the goto app for your web3 research and marketplace for nfts and project research.
This is akin to wechat and kakao that is used by users for all there web2 needs. We want to do something similar in web3
how_its_made:
react frontend and contracts. We are still exploring the sponsors that have zero knowledge and messaging.
Sponsors like
scroll - zero knowledge chain
hyperlane - cross chain messaging
sismo - selectively disclose personal data to applications
uma protocol - oracle to verify
